concept_map.chapter_overview: Aaj hum NCERT Class 6 Science (Curiosity / जिज्ञासा) ke Chapter 12 — पृथ्वी से परे — ko padhenge. Is chapter mein hum Yangdol aur Dorje ki Nubra (Ladakh) wali kahani se shuru karke raatri-aakaash ke taare, taara-mandal (constellations), saptarishi, Dhruva tara, light pollution aur night-sky observation seekhenge. Phir hum apne solar family — Suraj aur aath grahon — ke baare mein samjhenge, bilkul NCERT ke story-style flow mein.
concept_map.welcome: Namaste bacchon! Aaj hum Smart Board par ek bahut sundar chapter shuru karenge — पृथ्वी से परे. Socho, ek baar aisi raat jab aakaash bilkul saaf ho, aur upar lakhon taare chamak rahe hon — bilkul jaise Nubra, Ladakh mein Yangdol aur uske twin brother Dorje dekhte hain. Aaj hum unhi taaron, taara-mandalon aur apne Suraj-pariwar ki journey par chalenge. Ready ho? Chalo shuru karte hain!
learning_outcomes: Raatri-aakaash mein taaron ke patterns banakar unki pehchaan karna aur samajhna ki alag-alag log alag patterns/kahaniyan soch sakte hain
Taare aur taara-mandal (constellation) ka matlab batana; Orion, Canis Major, Lubdhak (Sirius) aur nakshatra names jaise Aardra, Rohini, Krittika ko pehchanna
Saptarishi (Big Dipper), Little Dipper aur Dhruva tara (Pole Star) se uttar disha ka pata lagana
Prakash-pradushan samajhkar night-sky observation ki taiyari karna; Suraj, AU, aur solar family ke aath grahon (Budh se Varun) ko kram se yaad rakhna

generated.concept: नुब्रा की कहानी और तारों के पैटर्न
generated.say: Bacchon, pehle ek sundar kahani suno — bilkul NCERT kitab ki tarah. Nubra, Ladakh ka ek bahut ramanlya kshetra hai. Wahan ek gaon mein gyarah saal ki balika Yangdol aur uska twin brother Dorje rehte hain. Unhe apne aas-paas ke gagan-chumbi parvat-shikhar aur himnadiyan bahut pyari hain, lekin sabse zyada pyara unhe raatri-aakaash lagta hai — jahaan taare jhilmilaate hain. Nubra mein mausam aksar badal-rahit rehta hai. Wahan air pollution aur light pollution almost nahi ke barabar hote, isliye raat ko aakaash bahut spasht dikhta hai. Yangdol aur Dorje kai raaton tak taaron ka avalokan karte hain aur asema vismay mehsoos karte hain. Bachpan se unhone parivaar se taaron ki dilchasp kahaniyan suni hain — prachin kaal mein saaf aakaash ke kuch vishesh taare Nubra se guzarne wale karvaan ke liye disha-soochak ka kaam karte the. Dono sochte hain — taare kitne bade hain, kitni door hain? Unhe taaron ke beech aise patterns dhoondhne mein anand aata hai jo kisi familiar vastu ki yaad dilate hain. Kya tumne kabhi raatri-aakaash mein taaron ko kalpanik lineon se jodkar picture banane ki koshish ki hai — jaise dots join karke drawing banate hain? Activity 12.1 kehti hai: chamakte taaron ko dekho, lines se jodo, jo jantu ya vastu dikhe uska naam likho, phir dost ke pattern se compare karo. Maza yeh hai ki tumhara pattern aur kahani alag ho sakti hai — aur yahi interesting baat hai! Pehla lesson: taare sirf points nahi — stories aur aakaash ke maps bhi hain.

generated.say: Ab section 12.1 — तारे और तारा-मंडल. Raatri-aakaash mein anek taare dikhte hain — kuch chamkeele, kuch dhundhle. Important: taare khud apne prakash se chamakte hain, self-luminous hote hain. Kuch taaron ke samuh aise patterns banate hue lagte hain jo jani-pehchani vastuon se milte-julte hain. Poorvajon ne in patterns ko jantuon, vastuon ya kahaniyon ke patraon ke roop mein pehchana; alag sabhyataon mein alag names the. In kalpanik aakritiyon ne aakaash mein taare pehchaanne mein madad ki. Prachin kaal mein yeh skill travellers ke liye useful thi — magnetic compass se pehle bhi naavikon aur yatriyon ko disha jaanne mein madad mili. Aaj bhi emergency mein yeh alternative method use hota hai. Pehle taara-samuhon ke patterns ko taara-mandal kaha jaata tha. Aaj arth thoda badla: taara-mandal aakaash ke us nishchit kshetra ko kehte hain jismein uske andar ke sabhi taare shaamil hote hain. Phir bhi patterns pehle nazar aate hain, isliye aksar hum shabd ko group ke liye bhi use karte hain. Orion aksar shikari ke roop mein — beech ke teen taare shikari ki belt. Kuch log kalpana karte hain Orion ek bail (Vrish/Taurus) se yuddha kar raha hai, aur uska kutta Canis Major peeche hai. Canis Major ka Lubdhak (Sirius) raatri-aakaash ka sabse chamkeela taara hai. IAU ne boundaries define ki — aaj 88 taara-mandal hain. Bharatiya khagol mein 'nakshatra' kisi taare ya taara-mandal ke liye use hota hai — Aardra (Beetlejuice), Krittika (Pleiades), aur Aldebaran yani Rohini.
generated.example: Orion ke beech ke teen taare — shikari ki belt — se pehchaan; uske paas sabse chamkeela taara Lubdhak (Sirius) Canis Major mein.

generated.concept: सप्तर्षि, लिटिल डिपर और ध्रुव तारा
generated.say: Ab Figure 12.4 — Big Dipper, Little Dipper aur Dhruva tara. Dhruva tara Little Dipper ka ang hai. Sabse important: Dhruva tara uttar disha mein almost achal — almost fixed — dikhai padta hai. Isliye uski madad se uttari golaardh mein uttar disha pehchani ja sakti hai. Big Dipper Ursa Major ka ang hai, Little Dipper Ursa Minor mein hai. Bharat mein Big Dipper ko Saptarishi kehte hain, Pole Star ko Dhruva tara. NCERT ka box suno — Bharat ke vanvasi samudayon aur janjatiyon ki kelapni stories bhi hain. Saptarishi ke woh char taare jo almost aayat (rectangle) banate hain — Madhya Bharat ki janjatiyan unhe dadi-maa ki charpai kehte hain, aur maanti hain teen chor (baaki teen taare) use chura rahe hain. Konkan-tat ke machhuaare inhi char taaron ko nauka maante hain, jinke antim teen taare nauka ki greeva hain. Same stars, alag cultures, alag stories! Science pattern dikhati hai, culture meaning deti hai. Yaad rakho: uttar chahiye toh Dhruva dhoondho — almost hilega nahi. Saptarishi usi raaste ka door hai. Agle concept mein exactly seekhenge kaise Saptarishi se Dhruva nikaalte hain. Abhi pakka: Saptarishi = Big Dipper = Ursa Major hissa; Little Dipper = Ursa Minor; Pole Star = Dhruva ≈ north, almost fixed. Aur mat bhoolna — Dhruva sabse chamkeela nahi; Lubdhak (Sirius) sabse chamkeela hai.
generated.example: Raat ko camping par agar compass na ho, Saptarishi dhoondhkar Dhruva tara nikaalo — uttar mil jaayega.

लिटिल डिपर = अर्सा माइनर; ध्रुव तारा इसका अंग
ध्रुव तारा ≈ उत्तर में लगभग अचल → उत्तर दिशा की पहचान
generated.common_mistake: Students sochte hain Dhruva tara aakaash ka sabse chamkeela taara hai — galat; Lubdhak (Sirius) sabse chamkeela hai, Dhruva tara bahut chamkeela nahi hota.
generated.memory_trick: S-L-D: Saptarishi → Little Dipper → Dhruva. 'Saptarishi se line banao, Dhruva mil jaaye'.
generated.gesture_action: Ek haath se 'ladle/dipper' shape banao (Saptarishi), doosre haath se north point karke 'Dhruva almost still' dikhao

generated.concept: रात्रि-आकाश का अवलोकन और प्रकाश प्रदूषण
generated.say: Section 12.2 — रात्रि-आकाश का अवलोकन. Agar kisi raat aakaash mein badal na hon, toh wahan badi sankhya mein taare dikh sakte hain. Lekin bade shehar mein aakaash kabhi-kabhar hi saaf hota hai aur sirf kuch taare dikhte hain. Kyun? Light pollution, dhuaan aur dhool ke kaaran. Raatri ke samay atyadhik kritrim prakash ki upasthiti ko prakash-pradushan — light pollution — kaha jaata hai. Gaon ya un kshetron mein jahaan light pollution kam hota hai, wahan zyada taare dikhte hain. Kabhi ghar oonche buildings aur pedon se ghira hota hai, isliye bada sky-area dekh hi nahi paate. Best observation = khule aur andhere sthan se. Important: sabhi taare aur taara-mandal prithvi ke sabhi sthanon se aur saal ki har raat nahi dikhte. Example — Dhruva tara dakshini golaardh se nahi dekha ja sakta. Pehchaan ke liye jaanna zaroori hai ki pattern kaisa dikhta hai aur kahan dekhna hai — Figures 12.3 aur 12.4 madad karte hain. Kab aur kahan dikhega, uske liye sky-mapping apps jaise Sky Map ya Stellarium use kiye ja sakte hain. World mein light pollution badh raha hai, isliye kuch dark-sky protected areas banaye gaye hain. Night-sky darshan ki taiyari: adults ke saath khula-andhera sthan; app se date-time; badal-rahit aur preferably bina chand wali raat — especially Dhruva ke liye kyunki woh bahut bright nahi; sky map, magnetic compass, notebook; pahunchne ke baad lagbhag aadha ghanta wait karo taaki aankhein andhere ke according adjust ho jaayein. Safety: raat ko bina adult ke andhere khule sthan mat jaao!
generated.example: Diwali ke baad shehar mein street lights aur ghar ke lights ke wajah se taare kam dikhte hain — yeh light pollution ka daily proof hai.

सर्वोत्तम अवलोकन = खुला + अँधेरा स्थान; आँखों को ~30 मिनट अँधेरे में समायोजित होने दो
सावधानी: वयस्क के बिना रात को अँधेरे स्थान पर न जाएँ
generated.common_mistake: Students sochte hain shehar mein taare kam isliye dikhte hain kyunki taare door chale gaye — actually taare wahi hain; light pollution, smoke aur dust unhe chhupa dete hain.
generated.memory_trick: DARK-30: Dark place + Adult + Ready map/compass + wait 30 minutes for eyes.
generated.gesture_action: Classroom lights thodi dim karke 'eyes adjusting' act karo — pehle kam, phir dheere-dheere zyada stars 'dikhte' hue dikhao

worked_example.problem: Tumhe Dhruva tara dhoondhna hai. Kis tarah ki raat aur taiyari best rahegi? Teen points likho.

worked_example.answer: Clear, preferably moonless night; open dark place with an adult; wait ~30 minutes for eyes to adjust; carry sky map/compass.

generated.concept: सप्तर्षि, ध्रुव तारा और ओरायन की पहचान
generated.say: Ab practical part — Activity 12.2 aur 12.3. Pehle Saptarishi aur Dhruva. Greeshma-ritu mein, raatri ~9 baje, aakaash ke uttari bhag mein Saptarishi pehchano. Jab mil jaaye, Dhruva nikaalo: Big Dipper ke cup ke antim do taaron ko dekho, unhe jodne wali seedhi line ki kalpana karo, line ko uttar ki ore badhao. In taaron ke beech ki doori ke lagbhag paanch gune doori par ek taara dikhega jo bahut chamkeela nahi — yahi Dhruva tara! Formula: Pointers → 5 times distance → Pole Star. Isi tarah Orion aur Lubdhak. Activity 12.3: Bharat mein Orion December se April tak, suryast ke baad ache se dikhta hai. Orion ke almost beech mein teen chamakdaar taare — shikari ki belt. Pehle in teen ko pehchano — yeh sabse aasan method hai. Ek baar Orion mil gaya, uske paas atyant chamakdaar Lubdhak easy ho jaata hai. Orion ke beech ke teen taaron se guzarati seedhi line ki kalpana karo aur line ke along poorv (east) dekho — wahi Lubdhak. Do skills: (1) Saptarishi pointers × 5 = Dhruva (north); (2) Orion belt → east = Lubdhak (brightest night star). Practice se aadat ban jaati hai — bilkul map padhna. Lines aakaash mein nahi dikhti — dimaag mein draw karte hain!

ओरायन (दिसंबर–अप्रैल, सूर्यास्त बाद): बीच के 3 तारे = बेल्ट
बेल्ट से पूर्व दिशा में रेखा → लुब्धक (सिरियस)
